Ellison’s calculations assumed Alameda could borrow $1.8 billion in normal dollars and $1.5 billion in crypto from FTX. The spreadsheet makes this clear with a row labeled “FTX borrows,” which Ellison said were customer funds.
In the recording, Ellison did indeed confess to stealing customer funds with Bankman-Fried’s approval.
